summary: Storage clock: three main pieces plus a separate small glue locator

required_interfaces.description: Separate small square locator between blind recesses, adhesive bond
通用石英钟芯空间及轴孔

assembly_story.installation: Dry-fit the separate locator, bond it in the base and body blind recesses, cure while supported, then install movement and removable dial
